name: MCP_PORTAL_URL
label: MCP portal URL
help: The portal's MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, https://), typically a Cloudflare MCP server portal, so Access decides who may connect and Gateway logs what crosses. Users never type a URL: this is the connector's whole portal. An unusable URL hides the connector.

name: MCP_PORTAL_NAME
label: Display name
help: Shown in the connector list and every approval prompt. Blank: "MCP Server Portal (<host>)".

name: MCP_PORTAL_AUTH
label: Sign-in (oauth, token or none)
help: "oauth" (blank means oauth): each person signs in through the portal. "token": every call carries the MCP_PORTAL_TOKEN secret. "none": the portal needs no credential.

name: MCP_PORTAL_TOKEN
label: Portal bearer token
help: Only for MCP_PORTAL_AUTH "token": the bearer token sent on every call to the portal. Leave blank otherwise.

name: MCP_PORTAL_TRUST_ANNOTATIONS
label: Trust tool annotations (true or blank)
help: "true" lets read-only annotations from servers behind the portal skip approval. Blank (off) unless you trust every upstream server the portal proxies: a portal's annotations are written by those servers, not by you.

name: MCP_PORTAL_HIDDEN_SERVER_IDS
label: Hidden upstream server IDs
help: Comma-separated upstream server IDs to leave out of the resource configurator and refuse, such as servers reached through their own native connector instead. Blank hides none.
